Oh, you made it! This is the Card Lab!
Just call me the Card Director.
Nice, you've got it!

That projection behind me is the
Neural Allied Virtual Interface Card Optimizer

Navico for short!
She teaches the rules to beginners, easy.

Right, let's start with Robattle basics!
Navico, take it from here!

Next up: Support Medabots.
Yep, the pals who back up your Leader!

Not bad!
Your Cross Attack was perfect too.

I'll go over the phases too.
Navico, over to you.

Team up and your attacks hit way harder.
Don't you forget it!

Next, the Leader's two arm parts!
Don't mix up right and left! Got it?

Nice one!
Parts and Quick cooldown, both nailed.

And now Quick cooldown.
Navico, the rest is yours!

Just watch how much Energy you have left!
Run out and you can't do a thing!

Next, how to defend when you're attacked!
Navico, take it away!
All right, looking good!

Block with a Barrier or with a part?
Read the field and decide!
Right, next up is your hand!
Perfect!

While we're at it, the Barrier Limit.
Navico, you're up!

Clinging to cards you can't play
won't win you the game! Careful!

Let's see if it all sank in:
time for a real Card Robattle!

Nice, you pass!
You've got it down cold!
No good! You haven't studied nearly enough!

Next up: the cards that aren't
Medabot units!
Next up: the Medaforce!
Nice, you've got it!

There are conditions to use it, so learn
them well. Navico, over to you!

The Medaforce is your trump card for
turning a match around! Don't forget it!
Right, next up: Tactics cards!
Perfect!

This bit's a little tricky, so focus up!
Navico, take it away!

Tactics cards can't be used without
Tactics stock. Never forget that!
And next up: Medafighter cards!
Nice, you've got it!

These are powerful too, so learn them well!
Navico, the rest is yours!

Only 1 Medafighter card per turn --
don't you forget it!

Now put everything you've learned
into practice with the Metabee deck!

Not bad at all!
From today you're a Medacard Fighter!

All right!
Bring it on!

...Now listen up.
Beyond here lie 7 areas.

Tough Medacard Fighters are waiting
in every one of them.

Beat them all and the door to the
next area opens up.

And standing in your way at the end...
the strongest Medacard Fighter of all!

Have you got what it takes to beat them?
Good luck out there!
